name: ABB Controller State
description: Read an ABB controller's state, operating mode, and RAPID execution state through the owner's serialized worker thread. Pure observe: never mutates the controller. Connects lazily on the first read.

inputParameters.name: controller
inputParameters.description: ControllerOwner from the ABB Controller component. Unconnected yields empty outputs with no error.

outputParameters.name: controller_state
outputParameters.description: Controller state string, e.g. motoron or guardstop.

outputParameters.name: operation_mode
outputParameters.description: Operating mode string, e.g. AUTO, MANR, or MANF.

outputParameters.name: execution_state
outputParameters.description: RAPID execution state as reported by the controller (opaque).
